cases.case_label: De novo L1 (LRE3-derived, 3' transduction) in CYBB
cases.mechanism_detail: A truncated L1 with a 3' transduction, derived from the source element LRE3 on 2q24.1, inserted into CYBB on the patient's maternal X; the insertion most likely arose in maternal meiosis I. The molecular consequence on CYBB is not described in the abstract.
cases.quote: We characterized a truncated L1 retrotransposon with a 3' transduction that was inserted, in a Dutch male patient, into the X-linked gene CYBB, thereby causing chronic granulomatous disease.
